Years later I installed Deepin Linux - replacing Windows - and fell in love. It's a Chinese disto built on Debian and it's downright beautiful. Most programmers focus on function over fashion, but the Deepin team really managed to turn their UI into a work of art - and all this during a time when the sexiest option was probably Elementary, which is overhyped in my opinion.

Unfortunately, Deepin was extremely laggy and system downloads were notoriously slow. I wasn't able to use it for long before switching back to Ubuntu.

Recently, I took the plunge and installed Arch (along with the Deepin Desktop Environment). I'm truly blown away.
